cards.title: Node CI
cards.code:
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build

cards.title: Least-Permission Token
cards.description: Set explicit permissions at workflow or job level.

cards.title: Concurrency
cards.description: Avoid overlapping deployments for the same target.

cards.title: Matrix Tests
cards.code:
strategy:
  matrix:
    node: [20, 22]
steps:
  - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
    with: { node-version: '${{ matrix.node }}' }

cards.title: Artifacts
cards.code:
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: test-report
    path: reports/
    retention-days: 7
cards.description: Store reports and build outputs with short retention.

cards.title: Supply-Chain Safety
cards.code:
pin third-party actions to a commit SHA
protect deployment environments
use OIDC instead of long-lived cloud keys
cards.description: Workflow changes can execute privileged code.
